verndale/migrator:
name: Renovate
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 6 * * *' # Daily at 06:23 UTC (01:23 EST / 02:23 EDT).
  workflow_dispatch:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [package-released]
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: pin-courier-private-coordinator
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  renovate:
    if: vars.PIN_COURIER_ENABLED == 'true' && github.event.repository.private == true
    uses: JFusco/renovate-config/.github/workflows/renovate-run.yml@c13f985540c9c23527aede87836eb08c285548f1 # v1.0.0
    with:
      target: verndale/migrator
    secrets:
      RENOVATE_APP_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.RENOVATE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
      RENOVATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENOVATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
